text: 住房城乡建设部、自然资源部、金融监管总局发布关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知。通知提到，加大融资支持力度。房地产项目实行主办银行制，房地产项目开发公司和主办银行双向选择，一个项目确定一家主办银行，主办银行单独或牵头组建银团提供开发贷款等融资服务。
text_en: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued a notice on improving the commercial housing sales system. The notice mentioned strengthening financing support. Real estate projects will adopt a lead bank system, where the project development company and the lead bank mutually select each other, one project designates one lead bank, and the lead bank alone or by forming a syndicated loan team provides development loans and other financing services.
